prompts.title: Rollout Table Constraint Trap
prompts.prompt:
Create a rollout plan as a compact Markdown table with exactly 6 body rows labeled S1 through S6.
Use columns: ID, Plan.

Constraints:
- S1 must name the user-facing effort setting.
- S2 must explain the local-only guarantee without using the word cloud.
- S3 must describe the private planning pass.
- S4 must say what happens if planning JSON fails.
- S5 must mention that scratchpads are not persisted.
- S6 must name one UI indicator for Psychic mode.
- Do not expose raw chain-of-thought.
- Keep the answer under 180 words.

runs.assistant:
| ID | Plan |
| --- | --- |
| S1 | Rollout of "Prism Pro" with enhanced features and user interface |
| S2 | Local-only guarantee ensures that all data is stored on the device, without relying on external servers or networks |
| S3 | Private planning pass allows users to create and manage plans in a secure environment, isolated from other users' data |
| S4 | If planning JSON fails, the system will revert to a default plan and notify the user of the error |
| S5 | Scratchpads are not persisted across sessions, requiring users to recreate them each time they log in |
| S6 | Psychic mode will be indicated by a glowing purple aura surrounding the user's avatar in the UI |

| ID | Plan |
| --- | --- |
| S1 | Effort setting to toggle Psychic Mode: "Mindful Insights" |
| S2 | Local data storage ensures no remote access, using secure, on-device models for enhanced user privacy and security. |
| S3 | Private planning pass provides exclusive developer insights into user behavior and preferences, with strict access controls and anonymized data storage. |
| S4 | Planning JSON failure results in default settings being reinstated, ensuring a seamless user experience and protecting sensitive information. |
| S5 | Scratchpads are not persisted across sessions, maintaining user confidentiality and preventing data leakage. |
| S6 | UI indicator: Toast notification with a subtle, pulsing badge for Psychic Mode activation or deactivation.
